commit.message:
docs: refresh repository presentation (#1)

- Restructure README to the standard Aspose FOSS repo-presentation template: banner,
  Navigation TOC, At a Glance diagram, Key Capabilities, Installation, Dependencies,
  Quick Start, Additional Examples, Project Structure, API Reference, Documentation &
  Resources, Scope and Limitations, Development and Testing, License.
- Add a real "## Dependencies" section listing every direct runtime crate dependency
  (chrono, zip, sha2, base64, serde_json, roxmltree, getrandom), each verified against
  the real Cargo.toml [dependencies] table -- and correct the prior Installation
  sentence, which stated no external runtime dependency existed while 7 real crates
  were declared.
- Ground the API Reference section in the real, current class/module structure and
  restore a verified Project Structure section.

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
